feed.title: Fifth Third Bank rolls out SmartShield in effort to help customers spot spoofing scams
feed.summary: Fifth Third Bank has launched SmartShield, a new feature in its mobile app designed to help customers identify and report potential phishing and spoofing scams. This tool allows users to submit screenshots of suspicious messages for bank review, with the goal of preventing customers from falling victim to increasingly sophisticated fraudulent attempts. The initiative comes during Cybersecurity Month, as financial institutions aim to combat scams where fraudsters impersonate banks to trick customers into moving money.

feed.title: Vertex (VRTX) or Regeneron (REGN)? Two Biotech Moats, Two Very Different Bets
feed.summary: This article compares the competitive advantages and investment potential of Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN), two leading biotech companies. Vertex has built its moat through dominance in cystic fibrosis and is now expanding into other therapeutic areas, while Regeneron's strength lies in its scientific research engine that consistently produces new medicines. Despite different strategies, both companies face challenges in pipeline diversification and patent expirations, with their valuations reflecting investors' current perceptions of these moats.
